notes.title: 【Demo】0113 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed overlapping music playback after death in boss battles.
[*] Fixed an issue where being rammed by a moose caused the character to die instantly.
[*] Fixed a bug where teleport points between trains were triggered earlier than intended.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing skills to be used in the real world.
[*] Fixed a bug where equipping a shield ignored its priority and deducted health directly, leading to death.
[/list]
